issues.issue: County fines and license fees passed through to the school (Schedule N p31 'County Fines and License Fees'); could be fines and forfeitures rather than county/other local governments. The statement-level County Receipts line (receipts[9]) as intergovernmental is defensible.

Every Schedule M 'Other Items' line (object 800) and Schedule G '3100-800 Other' (detail[228], 582.38) is mapped to dues, training and travel. Object 800 is a general catch-all (dues/fees, judgments, misc.), so this is an assumption; miscellaneous expenditure is the alternative.

issues.on_page: 2530 Printing, Publishing & Duplicating Services - Other Property Services 8,302.44
issues.issue: 'Other Property Services' is mapped to professional/contract services everywhere. Under 2530 Printing it is more likely printing, publishing and postage. The 2610 Operation of Buildings line (detail[149], 123,163.00) already has a review flag because it may be insurance/communications.
In plant operation, the Supplies object usually includes energy (natural gas/electricity), so part of this may be utilities (power, gas, phone). The page gives no breakdown.
Object 643 sits in the 600 supplies series (software); supplies and materials fits the object code better.
